title: Gold, silver and crude: long when price is above its 6, 7 or 12 month average, else flat
source: Clare, Seaton, Smith & Thomas et al. (2014), commodity futures trend following and momentum, City University London working paper (Section 4.1, Tables 4 and 8)
why: Paper: monthly trend following on DJ-UBS commodity indices, long when the price is above a 6-12 month moving average, otherwise cash. Long-only 7-month rule: annual excess return about 6.0%, Sharpe 0.76 (Table 4, Jan 1992-Jun 2011), lower drawdown than momentum; net of costs (Table 13). Approximations: the paper trades monthly on month-end prices, the engine uses daily closes with a 21-day hold; the paper's data are commodity indices, not the three CFDs here; the 6/7/12-month lengths are converted to 126/147/252 trading days.
